newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche Bahn awards 380 mln DM railway orders.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Bahn awards 380 mln DM railway orders.

text.p: Deutsche Bahn AG said on Monday it had given a group led by Siemens AG 380 million marks in orders for equipment to be used in building a high-speed rail line between Cologne and the Rhein-Main river junction.
The German railway said the group included Elpro, ABB Leitungsbau, and Deutsche Bahn's own railway construction division.

The contract covers signal and telecommunications equipment, wiring and switches, and electrical power equipment for the 135-km line, on which trains will travel at speeds of up to 300 kms per hour, Deutsche Bahn said.
The equipment will allow the railway to control the travel of all trains on the line from a single system.
The contract for the construction of the entire line was awarded in July, and budgeted at 3.6 billion marks. It is due for completion in 2000, and to begin operations in 2001.
